reviews.text: A huge thank you to Julie for her support since we adopted our little Lola. Thanks to her invaluable advice and training sessions, we have a well-adjusted and confident little beagle who knows how to handle the ultra-stimulating Parisian lifestyle and (almost) her emotions. We recommend her 100%!

I contacted Julie during the adoption process for Sesame to see if she could help us, as it was my first adoption and he came from a shelter in Romania.
She's been with us since he arrived, and I feel so incredibly lucky!
I honestly think I couldn't have found a better person! Sesame arrived very fearful of outsiders, and I didn't know the canine social cues, but Julie adapted to us completely. It was obvious from the very first session, and every session since has been beneficial and educational. I'm delighted to continue working with her, to see Sesame's progress, and to feel like I understand him better and better.
Thank you so much, Julie, and I can't wait to continue raising Sesame with you!
Fantastic both personally and professionally! Efficient, available, and attentive. I highly recommend him!

Julie is truly wonderful!

I contacted her after adopting my puppy Kai, who was very anxious and refused to go outside. I felt completely overwhelmed… Julie knew how to reassure me, and today Kai is transformed. He goes out without any problems, plays with other dogs, and lets new people approach him… I was very skeptical before meeting her, but I can tell you that I am completely convinced!! I am so grateful for this new, happy life with Kai. If you're hesitating, contact her! You won't be disappointed. 🙂

Since September, Julie has been providing exceptional support in training our dog. Her availability, teaching skills, patience, kindness, and thorough preparation are remarkable and make each training session incredibly effective and enjoyable. Thank you, Julie!

Julie is an exceptional professional whom I recommend a thousand times over! After just two sessions, the improvement in my dog ​​Feta's behavior (who is very reactive to external stimuli like children) is remarkable! Julie's analyses are very insightful, and everyone around me has noticed the positive change in Feta's behavior! We're continuing to work together to refine everything 🐾

Go for it! Julie's classes are fantastic!
My dog ​​progressed incredibly fast in just one session! Reasonable price and guaranteed results!

Julie was recommended to me by a friend, and I quickly understood why 🙂 I contacted her to help me with my little dog, Moka, a miniature dachshund. She's my very first dog, and I wanted to be well-guided in her training. Julie immediately put me at ease with her positive reinforcement training methods, her passion, and her unconditional love for dogs.

On a personal level, she's also incredibly pleasant: always smiling, kind, and attentive, which makes each session even more motivating.

She was an incredible support when Moka had an accident and had to recover for six weeks while she was still a puppy. Thanks to her advice and coaching, Moka is doing wonderfully today: she's happy, sociable, and well-adjusted!

Thank you so much, Julie ❤️
I recommend her 200%!

We have a miniature dachshund who wasn't comfortable in the city as a puppy, and we contacted Julie, who helped us a lot. Our dog is now thriving in the city, and we highly recommend Julie and her positive reinforcement training approach!

We wholeheartedly recommend Julie!

Her positive training methods and her lack of prejudice against large dogs convinced us to give her a try.

In addition to being a great teacher with our dog, she's just as skilled with us, ensuring every detail is perfected. She listens to your concerns, is very flexible, and always full of ideas.

Finally, she takes the time to understand your approach so she can adapt perfectly to your way of doing things.

We are delighted to call on her whenever we feel the need.

Julie is absolutely fantastic 👍 I highly recommend her. We had a baby and the relationship with our Australian Shepherd wasn't easy. We called Julie, who immediately reassured us and gave us the best advice. She uses positive reinforcement training methods. That's what makes all the difference. …

A wonderful person.

I think my dog, Orion, prefers her to me.

Don't hesitate, she's professional and honest, and she even whispers to dogs.

I called Julie in a moment of distress after adopting my dog. He had severe separation anxiety, and I was very anxious myself, constantly afraid of doing things wrong. I couldn't have found a better person! Julie's patience, kindness, empathy, and teaching skills are invaluable and rare. We've been working with Julie for four months now, and I can leave my dog ​​at home without any problems. He's now a very calm and serene dog, and so am I! Julie teaches us the values ​​of positive reinforcement, a training method so precious in the bond it creates between dog and human! I highly recommend contacting her!
Thank you for everything, Julie!
